headline: Davis & Elkins are the last unbeaten side
dek: Frostburg State went to Point Park unbeaten in six matches and lost, which leaves Davis & Elkins alone without a defeat after wins at West Liberty and Shawnee State. Charleston sit above them in the table, having won all five of their conference matches, but were beaten at home in August.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more than Davis & Elkins and Concord, the sides next to them in the table, together, and twelve different players have contributed to their twenty-seven; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Charleston scored ten in a single match against West Virginia Wesleyan, more than Wesleyan have scored all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Davis & Elkins have won six of their seven matches and conceded five goals in them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have won seven of their eight matches, scoring twenty-seven goals and conceding six.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after seven matches, with one draw and six defeats, and have conceded twenty-five goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has six goals and three assists for Frostburg State from sixteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Floyd Watts has made forty saves in Shawnee State's goal and been beaten fourteen times.

last_match.line: Davis & Elkins are still the only side without a defeat; Shawnee State have lost their last two without scoring.

next_match.line: Davis & Elkins are unbeaten; West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win and have lost every conference match they have played.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
